capabilities: Answer yes/no questions at chosen odds
Roll tension twists and scene outcomes
Track scenes, threads and NPCs in the note
Roll on linked notes as tables and draw playing cards
Append every roll to the note as plain Markdown
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant; answers come from dice rolled against odds you pick and from your own tables.
extras: Core features are free; a one-time $6 Pro purchase on itch adds a table library, table import, nested tables and story export. A browser demo runs the plugin over a sample note. Links inside the code block are not updated when a note is renamed.
problem: Playing a tabletop RPG alone needs something to answer questions, introduce twists and record what happened, which otherwise means juggling dice, tables and a separate log.
summary: Solo TTRPG oracle and GM emulator that answers yes/no questions, frames scenes, tracks threads and NPCs, and writes every roll into the note.
